what: One full-size run of the delivery chain (tools/possession_deliver.py) with the default release configuration possession-release.json (possession-v2.16 first) on the synthetic rehearsal bundle of K003 with the invented Smart Tagging file of K011 (file names, record counts and slot counts of the provided files; content: corrupted Metrica sample games with a simulated broadcast stream; an invented stretch before the second-half kick-off). The same bundle and options as possession-v215-rehearsal.json. Wiring and size check after the decision of K017, reporting only. Nothing here is from the provided match and nothing was selected with it.
environment: chain under Python 3.10.20 / numpy 1.26.4 / scipy 1.11.4 / pandas 2.1.4 (Linux, 2 CPUs); scoring under 3.13.18 / numpy 2.5.3 against stored labels (truth_stable.npz, the file-order Metrica proxy labels of K005; no label is recomputed)
options: --no-public-check --no-clone-check --quick (tests and cross-platform check included); simulated clock readings of K003
status_lines: [ 6] VERI ...................... OK (taktik VAR, yayin VAR, videolar YOK, smart tagging VAR)
[16] BELGE ..................... OK (Prova.md = teknik belge + calisma kaydi)

run_record_rows.System: possession-v2.16 (v2.15 with the players the tactical tracking has lost added from the broadcast tracking when the accuracy gate is open)
run_record_rows.Second model: used: the probabilities of the tree models were averaged with those of the temporal convolution network before the decoder
run_record_rows.Players added from the broadcast camera: used: players that the tactical tracking does not have at a moment and the registered broadcast tracking shows were added to the tracking the models see
run_record_rows.Kick-off rule: a kick-off tag of the automatic Smart Tagging was used: the frames of a graded block before that tag are written D
run_record_rows.Broadcast camera: files present; alignment: clock; accuracy gate open (missing tactical balls filled)

limits: The bundle is two corrupted Metrica sample games laid out by us with a simulated broadcast stream; one of them is game 3, which had been used in development. The scores are agreement with Metrica proxy labels on a synthetic layout; they are not competition scores and were not an input to any choice.
The broadcast stream of this bundle was made by the simulator of K003, which does not lose or invent players inside its window; the provided broadcast tracking may behave differently.
The Smart Tagging file is invented by us around kick-off frames we chose; it says nothing about the tags of the provided file.
The run used --quick: no repeat run, no run without clock readings, no fresh clone.
One machine (Linux). Whether the chain runs on the team's computer is checked there, by the team.
